rationale: The shortlist spans connected-device data-rights operations, multi-market product-safety syndication, payment-exception resolution, safer-gambling intervention evidence, packaging lifecycle and EPR change control, DORA contract-register reconciliation, DIWASS shipment routing, and neutral ESCO savings settlement. Each offers a founder-accessible data or automation wedge, channel-led distribution, repeat paid events, and a plausible compounding evidence or exception corpus; unvalidated API access, partner commitment, data rights, acceptance, volume, and economics remain adversarial research questions. Delayed history excluded battery-passport, F-gas, KSeF, CBAM, EUDR, CRA, AI-content-marking, medical-device-surveillance, NIS2-passport, pay-transparency, grid-submission, white-certificate, micropollutant, EHDS-catalog, CSIRE-retrofit, and PV diagnostic or claims families as direct or near-direct repeats. Only one DIWASS variant was retained to preserve semantic variety.
